moderationIntro: Review reported content independently. Visibility decisions never cancel an active transaction or its support duties.
dashboardIntro: Your current queues, permissions and prerequisites. No decided cases are added as sample content.
intakeIntro: Private records for onboarded brand and dealer technical staff. Intake is not an authentication or completed-work result.
signInBody: Use your marketplace account. The server checks your current permissions and represented organization on every request.
unavailableBody: No change was confirmed. Retry with the same request when the service recovers.
deniedBody: This account is not currently permitted to open these records.
stale: This record changed. Refresh it before making another change.
invalid: Check the fields and try again.
intake_exists: An intake already exists for this order and business. Open that record.
immutable_custody: The order and acknowledged custody receipt cannot be replaced.
custody_unconfirmed: Orders has not confirmed this custody receipt. The watch is not marked received.
custody_scope_mismatch: This receipt does not match the order, business or actual receipt time.
report_limit: Too many reports were submitted recently. Wait before retrying.
decision_required: Wait for a recorded decision before submitting an appeal.
idempotency_conflict: This request reference belongs to another payload. Refresh before submitting a new request.
evidenceHint: Do not paste payment credentials. Only your assigned reviewer may read this evidence.
emptyBody: This is a live empty queue, not a sample decided case.
claimHint: Private evidence opens only after assignment. You cannot review your own report or content.
assignment_required: This case is already waiting for a reviewer. Refresh the queue.
duties: Custody, payment, dispute and support duties remain in force. Hiding content does not cancel a sale.
deliveryPending: Decision saved; downstream application is still pending.
reviewSignals: Rules for human review only — not a fraud judgment
report_velocity: Five or more reports in ten minutes
reported_payment_abuse: Payment abuse was reported; no finding is implied
prerequisites: This queue needs actual custody, the eligible transaction state and an assigned reviewer. No result can be recorded yet.
commandsUnavailable: Result commands are not released for this queue.
privateEvidenceHint: Up to ten files, 256 KiB each. JPEG, PNG or WebP photos; prior-owner records may also be PDF. Only currently authorized staff in this business can download them. No public preview is created.
invalid_evidence: Use a supported file of at most 256 KiB with a matching file type.
evidence_limit: This intake already has ten private files.
evidence_exists: This file is already attached to this intake.
custodyHint: Without a verified custody receipt, this record stays awaiting intake. No watch is marked received.
feeHint: Use whole cents for USD; whole piastres for LBP. No fee is collected by this record.
custodyNotCurrent: The recorded receipt is not currently confirmed by Orders. Historical records remain available, but diagnostic opening is not authorized.
diagnosisAllowed: Diagnostic opening is permitted for this received watch.
diagnosisNotAllowed: Diagnostic opening is not authorized by this record.
noPass: No authentication, quality or completed-work pass has been recorded.
independent_review_required: Another independent reviewer must handle this report.
